decisions.reason: Confirm the locked identifier at cp 2949. The DOI 10.1088/0004-637X/741/2/68 sits in the path of a publisher URL (/article/10.…, not /doi/10.…) in the url= field of a citation template inside a <ref>. Section 3.5 gives the publisher-URL whole-URL rule only for /doi/ paths, so the raw text is the identifier text ('anything else' row). The role identifier_link fits a publisher URL in url= pointing at the identifier. The engine missing it does not make it not an occurrence. Ambiguity: the guide does not say how a non-/doi/ publisher URL is quoted; the identifier-text reading was chosen.
